patient.name: David Hughes
patient.persona: An employed accountant who lives with his wife and two children, speaks clearly and provides detailed responses when questioned, remains cooperative throughout the consultation.
patient.openingLine: I've had diarrhoea for the last three days and it's been affecting my day-to-day activities.

facts.text: I've had diarrhoea for the last three days.
facts.quote: I've just had some diarrhea for the last three days

facts.text: It's been affecting my day-to-day activities and I need to stay close to the toilet.
facts.quote: it's been affecting me I need to stay close to the toilet. And, um, yeah, it's been affecting my day-to-day activities.

facts.text: My stools are loose and watery, and I go to the toilet about six or seven times a day.
facts.quote: Yeah, so it's like loose and watery stool, going to the toilet quite often

facts.text: I have cramp-like pain in my lower left abdomen that comes and goes.
facts.quote: it feels, um, like a cramp, like a muscular cramp

facts.text: I feel weak and shaky, especially when the symptoms started.
facts.quote: yeah i feel a bit uh weak and shaky.

facts.text: I had a fever around three or four days ago when the symptoms started.
facts.quote: I did notice um a temperature when the symptoms started, so, um, yeah around about three or four days ago.

facts.text: I vomited at the start of the symptoms but have now stopped vomiting.
facts.quote: I vomited at the start of the symptoms but now um I've stopped vomiting.

facts.text: I've had a loss of appetite but I can still hold down fluids.
facts.quote: I had a loss of appetite, um, so I haven't been eating as much, but I've been able to hold down fluids.

facts.text: I've been eating soups, smoothies and other liquid foods.
facts.quote: just soups, and, uh, yeah, light foods. Like smoothies and, yeah, liquid foods mainly.

facts.text: I had takeaway from a Chinese restaurant about four days ago.
facts.quote: Yeah, so I had takeaway about four days ago

facts.text: No one else in my household has had the same symptoms as me.
facts.quote: no one else in the family, so ... a wife and two kids and one, um, child was vomiting, but they haven't got diarrhea. There's no one with the same symptoms.

facts.text: I have asthma but it is well-controlled with an inhaler.
facts.quote: other than um athsma, um I use an inhaler, everything uh else is fine.

facts.text: I am not taking any other medications besides my inhaler.
I do not smoke or drink alcohol.
I work as an accountant and have been going to work despite the symptoms, which has been difficult.
facts.quote: Uh, yes, yeah. I I work, er. Um, I'm an accountant.

facts.text: I am worried that my symptoms might be caused by something serious since they are not improving quickly enough.
facts.quote: Because if it is ongoing then we have to wonder whether something else caused your symptoms.
